ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 15:85 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity black pigment across both lobes. Numerous discrete high-intensity white blobs (annular and solid circular patterns) are distributed across the surface, with a high-density cluster on the distal third of the left lobe and a similar dense mapping on the outer margin of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 50-55 degrees; the notch depth occupies roughly 18% of the vertical bounding box of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits moderate-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (~5-7 distinct peaks). Right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, irregular jagged topography, particularly on the distal third where amplitudes increase significantly relative to the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a predominantly linear/straight trajectory towards the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular and ring-shaped white pixel clusters across the entire visible surface; highest density constellations are observed near the leading edge of the left lobe and the distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible on the medial portion of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tip of the right lobe shows significant irregular structural loss and dense high-intensity scarring, likely indicating a site of heavy former parasitic colonization or minor physical impact.
other_distinctive_markers: The fluke displays a rare density of 'ring-like' annular scars that dominate the visual texture of the pigmented areas.
